summary: Sprites are classified into two groups by their color pattern, then the patterns are swapped between groups while preserving each sprite's scale and maximizing position overlap.
src: polychrome sprites with distinct color combinations s
dst: matched sprite from opposite pattern group d
transform: swap s.color_pattern with d.color_pattern while preserving s.scale
multi_step: Step 1: identify all non-background sprites; Step 2: classify sprites into two groups by color pattern (e.g., group A has teal/green, group B has red/green); Step 3: swap color patterns between matched pairs while keeping positions with maximum overlap, and same scale
